_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Lists and updates the site support inbox; signals and monitor create for proactive detection. Approving a reply always needs a person; the tool returns the Slack link.

description: Support inbox for a site (Dotsy uses dotsy-home). list counts first, get summary first, reply, update, signals, and monitor create. approve always needs a person.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

evidence.description: create (monitor): required internal evidence note, including upsert counts.

fingerprint.description: create (monitor): server rule id `R1:…`, `R2:…`, `R5:…`, or daily log `L:worker:hash`.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

messageId.description: approve: which draft. The tool still cannot approve.

runId.description: create (monitor): automation run id for idempotent filing.

since.description: signals: ISO start time; wins over window when both are set.

site.description: Inbox site. Dotsy's inbox is dotsy-home.

name: support_inbox
